CheckSqlContent.description_en: Validates a specified Flink SQL statement
CheckSqlContent.description_zh: 用于校验给定的 Flink SQL 语句是否符合规范

CreateComputeInstance.description_en: Creates a compute instance. This operation only completes the purchase phase. After the instance is created, you must call StartComputeInstance to complete network configuration and deployment
CreateComputeInstance.description_zh: 创建一个计算实例。接口只完成购买阶段；创建成功后需调用 StartComputeInstance 完成网络配置和部署

CreateComputeJob.description_en: Creates a Flink SQL job on a running compute instance
CreateComputeJob.description_zh: 在运行中的计算实例上创建一个Flink SQL作业

DeleteComputeInstance.description_en: Deletes a compute instance that is in the pending deployment, stopped, or released state
DeleteComputeInstance.description_zh: 删除处于待部署、已停止或已释放状态的计算实例

DeleteComputeJob.description_en: Deletes a specified compute job. A successful request indicates that the deletion request has been accepted
DeleteComputeJob.description_zh: 用于删除指定的计算作业，请求成功表示删除已受理

GetComputeInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified compute instance
GetComputeInstance.description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用 GetComputeInstance 查询指定计算实例的详情

GetComputeJob.description_en: Queries the details of a compute job in AlikafkaStreaming by specifying parameters in a parameter query
GetComputeJob.description_zh: 通过指定参数查询AlikafkaStreaming中计算作业的详细信息

ListComputeInstancesInPage.description_en: This topic describes how to call ListComputeInstances to perform a paging query of compute instances under the current account
ListComputeInstancesInPage.description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用 ListComputeInstances 分页查询当前账号下的计算实例

ListComputeJobs.description_en: Queries information about all jobs under a specified compute instance by using paging
ListComputeJobs.description_zh: 用于分页查询指定计算实例下的所有作业信息

ReopenComputeInstance.description_en: Reactivates a stopped pay-as-you-go compute instance. A successful response indicates that the reactivation request has been accepted
ReopenComputeInstance.description_zh: 重新启用一个已停止的后付费计算实例。接口返回成功表示启用请求已受理

StartComputeInstance.description_en: Configures the network and initiates the deployment for a compute instance in the pending deployment state
StartComputeInstance.description_zh: 为处于待部署状态的计算实例配置网络并发起部署

StartComputeJob.description_en: Starts, resumes, or tests a compute job
StartComputeJob.description_zh: 用于启动、恢复或调试一个计算作业

StopComputeInstance.description_en: Stops a running pay-as-you-go compute instance. A successful response indicates that the stop request has been accepted
StopComputeInstance.description_zh: 停止一个正在运行的后付费计算实例。接口返回成功表示停止请求已受理

StopComputeJob.description_en: Stops a compute job in the specified region and instance
StopComputeJob.description_zh: 用于停止指定地域和实例下的计算作业

UpdateComputeInstanceName.description_en: Updates the name of a compute instance. The instance must be in the deployment preparation or running state
UpdateComputeInstanceName.description_zh: 修改计算实例名称。实例需处于部署准备阶段或运行中状态

UpdateComputeJob.description_en: Modifies the remarks of a specified compute job
UpdateComputeJob.description_zh: 用于修改指定计算作业的备注

UpdateComputeJobCu.description_en: Modifies the CU limit and reserved CUs for a specified computing job
UpdateComputeJobCu.description_zh: 用于调整指定计算作业的CU上限与预留CU值

UpdateComputeJobDraftSql.description_en: Updates the Flink SQL draft saved for a specified compute job
UpdateComputeJobDraftSql.description_zh: 更新指定计算作业保存的Flink SQL草稿
